name: FileUpload
description: Uploads a file to a specified SharePoint document library location using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: Destination Folder Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the destination folder where the file should be uploaded. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFolder

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: File Name
fields.description: The name of the file to be uploaded, including the file extension (e.g., Document.pdf).

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: The MIME type of the file being uploaded (e.g., application/pdf for PDF files).

fields.name: FileContent
fields.label: File Content (Base64)
fields.description: The content of the file to be uploaded, encoded in Base64 format.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the file upload operation, including success status and any error messages.
